jobs.title: Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)

Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10

Het mooie van werken bij Univé

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?

Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.

Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.

Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met zowel Synergy als Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar functionele requirements.

  • Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig uit te werken en anderen daarin mee te nemen.

  • Ervaring met het inhoudelijk begeleiden en coachen van collega-analisten.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en IT.

  • Kennis van Agile/Scrum en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams.

Ervaring met systeemmigraties, juridische dienstverlening of de verzekeringsbranche is een pré.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Business Analist werk je binnen het Rechtshulp Synergy-team aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap voor onze juridische dienstverlening.

De migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden.

Je brengt bestaande processen en informatievoorziening in kaart, onderzoekt welke verbeteringen mogelijk zijn en vertaalt deze naar heldere requirements voor de nieuwe omgeving.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt welke impact veranderingen hebben op medewerkers, processen en uiteindelijk onze leden.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe business- en procesanalyses.

  • Het analyseren van bestaande Synergy-processen en het vertalen hiervan naar de gewenste inrichting binnen Dynamics.

  • Het ophalen, uitwerken en valideren van businessrequirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken van afhankelijkheden tussen processen, applicaties en andere IT-teams.

  • Het adviseren van de Product Owner en businessstakeholders over oplossingsrichtingen en verbeterkansen.

  • Het inhoudelijk begeleiden van andere businessanalisten en bewaken van de kwaliteit van analyses.

  • Het ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en acceptatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en de verdere professionalisering van businessanalyse.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Binnen de eerste zes maanden heb je de belangrijkste Rechtshulp-processen geanalyseerd en vertaald naar bruikbare requirements voor Dynamics.

Daarnaast heb je inhoudelijk richting gegeven aan de migratie en een zichtbare bijdrage geleverd aan de kwaliteit en zelfstandigheid van de andere analisten.

Je team

Je komt terecht in het Rechtshulp Synergy-team binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies.

Het team maakt onderdeel uit van IT Distributie, waar we nauw samenwerken met onze businesscollega's om de dienstverlening van Univé continu te verbeteren.

Je werkt in een team waarin medewerkers veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgen. We verwachten dat je zelfstandig kunt werken, initiatief toont en actief de samenwerking opzoekt.

Als senior krijg je een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol, zonder dat je formeel leidinggevende bent.

Je bent iemand bij wie collega's terechtkunnen voor complexe vraagstukken, maar die ook zelf graag de inhoud induikt.

Je standplaats is Assen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Univé krijg je een uitdagende functie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening.

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je vakinhoudelijke kennis in te zetten en collega's verder te helpen.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10.

Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

Daarnaast bieden we onder andere:

  • Een variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris.

  • Een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd.

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek.

  • Een goede studiekostenregeling en mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een goede pensioenvoorziening.

  • Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

  • Korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatie zonder winstoogmerk. We helpen onze leden risico's te voorkomen, gevolgen te beperken en problemen op te lossen.

Binnen Juridisch Advies ondersteunen we leden bij juridische vragen en problemen. Goede digitale ondersteuning helpt onze collega's om deze dienstverlening persoonlijk, toegankelijk en efficiënt te houden.

IT Distributie speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. We ontwikkelen en verbeteren de IT-oplossingen waarmee onze collega's hun werk kunnen doen en onze leden goed geholpen worden.

Daarbij geloven we in eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de ruimte om zelf verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met Synergy en Microsoft Dynamics inzetten om onze juridische dienstverlening toekomstbestendig te maken?

En krijg je energie van een rol waarin je complexe analyses combineert met het begeleiden van collega's?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteer op de functie van Senior Business Analist Rechtshulp bij Univé.

Du bist gerade mitten im Studium und auf der Suche nach einem flexiblen Werkstudentenjob oder einem Praktikum im Recruiting, den Du 100 % Remote ausüben kannst?

Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Recruiting oder Active Sourcing gesammelt und möchtest sie jetzt in echten Mandaten vertiefen? Du hast Spaß am direkten Kontakt mit Bewerbern und möchtest uns im täglichen Rennen um neue Talente unterstützen?

Dann lies unbedingt weiter.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Recruiting Teams in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent oder Praktikant Recruiting / Active Sourcing (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland.

Unser Must-have: Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise im Active Sourcing. Alles andere lässt sich lernen – und wir passen den Job Deinen Stärken an.

Deine Aufgaben:

Personio, Ashby), stehst im aktiven Austausch mit nationalen sowie internationalen Talenten (Terminvereinbarung, Nachforderung fehlender Informationen, Absagen) und sorgst mit Deiner professionellen Bewerberkommunikation für eine positive Candidate Experience.

Manager I, Engineering - Security Libraries
Technology Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market.

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows, helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do

Technology & Product Narrative

  • Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

  • Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

  • Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

  • Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework

  • Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

  • Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

  • Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

  • Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation

  • Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

  • Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

  • Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration)

  • Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

  • Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

  • Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are

Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

  • You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

  • Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

  • Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

  • Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Ways of working

  • Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

  • Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

  • Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

  • Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer, Agentic Engineering
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Staff Platform Engineer, Agentic Engineering

Developer Productivity · AI Coding Agents · Developer Platform

Our ambition: an engineering organisation where humans and agents work as one continuously learning system, turning frontier AI capabilities and real-world feedback into more ambitious product development. We want n8n to be the reference for how this is done, without compromising quality, resilience or trust. Your main goal is to make that real.

This is a Staff individual contributor role in Developer Platform and the technical driving force behind ACDC (Agent-centric Development Cycle), our engineering-wide initiative for agentic development. Nobody has a playbook for this yet. You'll write ours.

You won't start from zero. Agents wired into Linear already automate around 80% of the development cycle on one of our developer platform projects, alongside pilots for insight, feature-flag and PR-review agents and a shared agent harness. Your job is to take this from promising experiments to the way n8n builds software.

This role is for someone who thinks about this problem constantly. You run agents all day, rebuild your own workflow every time the frontier moves, and have more ideas than time.

You'll stay hands-on, building the first versions yourself, and shape how the work grows beyond one person.

What you'll do

Set direction and own the outcome

  • Identify where agentic development can make the greatest difference, using developer feedback, existing experiments and engineering performance data.

  • Set the strategy and priorities across agent execution, repository readiness, CI, security and developer workflows.

  • Make build, buy or pass decisions on tools and vendors, and own the cost and value trade-offs, including AI spend.

  • Make decisions where requirements are incomplete and the trade-offs between autonomy, reliability, security and review effort are still emerging.

  • Build alignment through technical proposals, clear decisions and working software, and report progress and impact to engineering leadership.

Build the foundations

  • Design and build isolated execution environments where agents can work with the right access to code, tools and context, without exposing secrets or sensitive systems.

  • Own the safety model: which task categories agents may attempt, what they must never touch, and where human review is required, partnering with Security on sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions and data handling.

  • Make n8n's monorepo agent-ready, working with Architecture and senior engineers on repo structure, testability, boundaries and the context agents need.

Integrate agents into how we work

  • Build repeatable workflows that take Linear issues through agent execution, self-verification and review to merged PRs, across a growing range of task types.

  • Integrate agentic workflows with GitHub, CI, test infrastructure and code review, so the agentic path becomes the easiest path for engineers.

  • Extend the loop beyond coding: connect earlier signals like product research and customer requests, and later ones like production metrics, so agents contribute across the whole cycle.

  • Open it up beyond engineering, so PMs, designers and others can turn a well-defined issue into a reviewed, mergeable change.

  • Shape review practices, such as PR evidence that shows what changed, what ran, what risks remain and where human judgment is needed.

Measure what works

  • Build benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate output quality, failure modes, review burden and production risk.

  • Define and track quality and adoption signals, such as reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate and developer satisfaction.

  • Use data and feedback to change course, retire what doesn't work, and build trust across engineering.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🔥 Frontier obsession: You live at the frontier. You try new models and tools as they land, and you have strong, evidence-backed opinions on what's real and what's hype.

  • 🧭 Staff-scope ownership: You’ve led complex platform, DevEx or engineering productivity initiatives across teams, from defining the problem to sustained adoption and measurable impact, where there was no established approach to follow.

  • 🤖 Agentic depth: You use coding agents daily as a power user, and you've built infrastructure around them, such as repo context and instructions, tool or MCP integrations, sandboxed execution or agent workflows in CI, that other engineers rely on.

  • 🎯 Product mindset for internal platforms: You treat engineers as your customers. You start from real friction, prioritise by impact, make build-vs-buy calls, weigh cost against value, and let adoption tell you whether something works.

  • 🤝 Direction without authority: You've set technical direction that multiple teams followed, through proposals, design reviews and credibility with senior engineers across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security and Architecture.

  • 🔐 Safety judgment: You've made real decisions on permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths and human-in-the-loop review, and can explain the trade-offs.

  • 📊 Measurement that drives decisions: You've built evaluations, benchmarks or quality metrics and used them to change course or retire things that didn't work. You care about outcomes, not lines of AI-generated code.

  • ✍️ Writing that changes decisions: Your technical proposals and documentation have shifted what teams did.

Nice-to-haves

  • 📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js or JavaScript monorepo.

  • ⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, test infrastructure, preview environments or internal developer platforms.

  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Growing a team: You've mentored engineers or helped shape a new team as an initiative grew beyond one person.

  • 🌍 Open-source communities: You have contributed to open-source or source-available projects with active developer communities.

  • 🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling and customer trust are central.

  • 🔗 Workflow automation: You're familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration or developer-facing products.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe's fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies. Your work will shape the platform foundations, safety model, evaluation framework and developer workflows that decide whether agents can contribute meaningfully to production engineering without lowering the quality bar.

You'll join a remote-first team with high autonomy, high visibility and a strong builder mindset. Because this is a first-of-its-kind role, you'll set direction, influence engineering culture, and create learnings that may inform both our internal engineering and n8n's product thinking.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Device Platform (all genders)
jobs.description:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

 

Engineering Manager - Device Plattform (all genders)

 

Your Role & Impact

At tonies, we are continuously evolving our device and system architecture to strengthen the foundation for future product experiences. As Engineering Manager for the Device Platform team, you define the system architecture (RTOS, Embedded Linux, Android, or alternatives) and deliver a stable, performant firmware platform that ‘Experience teams’ can build against with confidence.

In our JDM setup, the manufacturing partner handles electronics hardware, low-level drivers, BSP, and mechanics, while your team steers platform decisions to ensure a reliable, product-grade system. You will scale our existing core team, primarily through external engineering partners, to drive our platform roadmap.

Our device architecture is feature-rich, battery-powered, and connected—requiring expertise in connectivity, sensors, tight power budgets, and real-time requirements.

 

What you'll do

  • Team Leadership & Build-up: Take ownership of the existing team and scale it — largely through external partners — while building a cohesive engineering culture across internal staff, external engineers, and JDM partner engineers.

  • Platform Selection & Architecture: Drive the programme's most consequential technical decision: choosing and validating the system platform based on product requirements, resource constraints, time-to-market, and long-term extensibility.

  • JDM Steering: Act as the engineering counterpart to the JDM on electronics and firmware — defining deliverables, setting quality standards, reviewing hardware designs and drivers, and ensuring BSP drops integrate cleanly.

  • Interfaces & Delivery: Experience teams specify the APIs they need; your team delivers them reliably. You turn every boundary — JDM below, experience teams above — into a testable contract rather than a coordination bottleneck.

  • Leading Through Ambiguity: Requirements will shift, trade-offs will be sharp (performance vs. battery, flexibility vs. time-to-market). You keep the team productive and aligned through that uncertainty.

  • Technical Credibility: Stay close enough to the firmware to challenge architectural choices, evaluate JDM deliveries with authority, and step in on critical problems yourself.

  • Delivery Excellence: Own milestones, JDM integration gates, and release cadence to the experience teams — keeping the programme plannable and on track.

Your team's responsibilities

  • Evaluating, selecting, and bringing up the system platform (RTOS, embedded Linux, Android, or hybrid)

  • Owning the firmware stack above the BSP: OS configuration, middleware, system services, power management, connectivity, and security

  • Delivering the APIs specified by experience teams, decoupling feature development from platform internals

  • Steering the JDM on electronics and firmware: specifying deliverables, managing BSP integration, holding quality standards

  • Ensuring platform stability through automated testing, integration gates, and systematic validation of JDM deliveries

  • Contributing to the broader tonies® platform strategy where it makes sense

 

What You Bring

  • Leadership: You have led engineering teams and built or significantly grown at least one. You know how to step into a small team, set direction, and scale it — including sourcing, onboarding, and managing a majority of external engineers alongside a smaller internal core.

  • Leading Across Boundaries: You have run a team where external engineers are the planned model, not a temporary supplement. You know how to create shared standards, retain critical knowledge in-house, and keep partner relationships collaborative. JDM/ODM experience is a strong plus.

  • Deep Embedded Platform Expertise: The core of the role. Years of hands-on experience with embedded system platforms — ideally more than one of RTOS, embedded Linux, or Android — and a well-founded opinion on when each is the right choice.

  • Connected-Device Experience: You have worked on resource-constrained, battery-powered, connected devices. Power management, wireless connectivity, sensor integration, and tight hardware budgets are familiar territory.

  • Architectural Vision: Modular, well-layered systems with clean separation between BSP, platform services, and application layer — so experience teams move fast without destabilising the foundation.

  • The Toolbox: C/C++ is your native language. At home in Linux, comfortable with hardware-near debugging (JTAG, logic analysers), Git, GitLab, and CI/CD as daily workflow.

  • Work Style: Pragmatic, technically rigorous, comfortable with ambiguity. You communicate confidently in professional English (German is a plus) and collaborate with your team in a hybrid setup.

  • Last but not least: You are enthusiastic about our product and want to join us on our exciting journey!

 

Why Join Us?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.

  • Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.

  • Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.

  • Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.

  • Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!

  • Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faiths and genders. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

The role

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

 

What You Will Do

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

  • A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

  • You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

  • You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

  • Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

  • 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

  • Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.

Nice to have

  • Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

jobs.description:

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Mistral AI is building a new Compute Support team to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our GPU clusters in a Kubernetes environment. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its processes, standards, and culture.

In this hybrid L1/L2 support role, you will be the first point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for compute-related inquiries. You’ll also serve as the escalation point for complex issues, leveraging your deep systems knowledge, Kubernetes expertise, and operational debugging skills to ensure our AI workloads run smoothly at scale.

This is a support-focused role that blends system administration, customer-facing communication, and compute infrastructure expertise. While coding is not the primary focus, familiarity with Go for debugging and automation is a plus.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

First Customer’s Point of Contact

  • Act as the first interlocutor for customers and internal teams, providing timely and effective responses to compute-related inquiries.

  • Triage and prioritize incoming requests, ensuring SLAs are met for acknowledgment, first response, and resolution.

  • Gather and analyze initial issue details (e.g., logs, error messages, system metrics) to diagnose problems efficiently.

  • Provide clear, actionable guidance to customers and internal users, including temporary workarounds where applicable.

 
 

Technical Support

  • Serve as the L2 escalation point for Linux, Kubernetes, and compute infrastructure issues, providing deep technical troubleshooting for:

    • GPU/TPU workloads (e.g., CUDA errors, memory leaks, job failures).

    • Kubernetes clusters (e.g., pod crashes, node failures, networking misconfigurations).

    • Bare metal and cloud environments (e.g., AWS EC2, GCP VMs, HPC clusters).

  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, hardware failures, and resource contention in distributed systems.

  • Analyze system metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., dmesg, journalctl, nvidia-smi, Prometheus, Grafana) to identify root causes of issues.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for critical compute systems

  • Nice to have: Optimize system configurations (e.g., kernel parameters, filesystem tuning, network settings) for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads.

 
 

Kubernetes & Containerization

  • Debug Kubernetes clusters with a focus on:

    • Pod and node issues (e.g., CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes, StorageClasses).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes, node affinity).

  • Troubleshoot container runtime issues (Docker, containerd) such as image pull failures, OCI compliance, or runtime errors.

  • Collaborate with SRE teams to understand and improve existing IaC (Terraform, Ansible) and Go-based tooling.

 
 

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation for common compute issues (e.g., GPU debugging, Kubernetes troubleshooting).

  • Help define and refine support processes as a founding member of the new Compute Support team.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in system administration, technical support, or infrastructure operations, with a strong focus on compute-heavy environments (bare metal, cloud, HPC, or virtualization).

  • Deep Linux/Unix expertise:

    • Debugging kernel-level issues (e.g., OOM killer, I/O bottlenecks, CPU throttling).

    • Performance tuning (e.g., sysctl, ulimit, filesystem optimizations).

    • Networking troubleshooting (e.g., iptables, tcpdump, DNS, NFS, SSH).

    • Storage management (e.g., LVM, RAID, NVMe, GPU-local storage).

  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience is mandatory:

    • Debugging pods, nodes, and clusters (e.g., kubectl describe, kubectl logs, crictl).

    • Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes).

    • Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes).

  • Experience with bare metal, virtualization, or HPC environments (e.g., Fluidstack, Coreweave, Vast) is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Senior Consultant based in Switzerland.

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on engineering expert, helping enterprise customers design, implement, and scale advanced agentic AI solutions. You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the technical success of enterprise customers' agentic AI initiatives, managing the complete delivery lifecycle from initial discovery and solution design through development, production deployment, ongoing operations, and advisory services.
  • Lead customer workshops to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value agentic AI use cases, translating business objectives into measurable and technically achievable workflows.
  • Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent architectures, including agent decomposition, orchestration, task delegation, tool integration, memory management, state handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Develop, review, and troubleshoot production-quality software using Go or Python, building agents, plugins, tools, and integrations that meet enterprise requirements.
  • Deploy and operate agentic AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and legacy systems through MCP servers, A2A protocols, REST APIs, and event-driven messaging architectures.
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, knowledge bases, embeddings, and real-time event context strategies to improve agent accuracy and access to relevant information.
  • Apply the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) throughout solution delivery, covering requirements gathering, architecture design, evaluation pipelines, testing, version control, release management, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Establish robust observability, security controls, governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices for agentic systems, including tracing, quality evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control, and auditability.
  • Advise customers on large language model selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, considering prompt engineering, token consumption, costs, and model performance trade-offs.
  • Act as a long-term technical advisor, identifying opportunities for further AI adoption and helping customers progress from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide, event-driven AI implementations.
  • Conduct recurring technical reviews, solution health checks, and roadmap discussions aligned with customer priorities and annual planning cycles.
  • Enable customer engineering teams to independently operate, maintain, and extend implemented solutions through technical workshops, collaborative development sessions, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Develop reusable technical assets, including reference architectures, implementation patterns, accelerators, and best practices, to improve delivery efficiency and consistency across future engagements.
  • Represent customer needs and technical feedback to internal Product and Engineering teams, contributing insights that influence product development and roadmap priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with agentic AI platform engineering teams to resolve complex customer challenges, validate new capabilities, and contribute reusable agents, plugins, and accelerators.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other professionals, helping strengthen agentic AI expertise and delivery capabilities across the Professional Services organization.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, AI-related risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Travel when required to support customer engagements, including occasional international travel.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in professional services, technology consulting, systems integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions, including at least one solution successfully taken into production.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management, with practical experience applying a structured Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC).
  • Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with Go considered a significant advantage.
  • Practical experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making.
  • Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with agent interoperability and tool integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, and designing APIs for agent-based applications.
  • Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and context management techniques.
  • Experience implementing evaluation frameworks, observability solutions, and security guardrails for enterprise LLM applications.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience deploying distributed applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of enterprise security and identity management practices relevant to AI systems, including OAuth 2.0, role-based access control (RBAC), secrets management, and data privacy.
  • Ability to independently lead customer engagements, make sound technical decisions, and manage complex projects with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience facilitating technical workshops and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English and either Spanish or Italian, both written and spoken.
  • Experience working with agentic AI platforms or enterprise messaging technologies is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Solace Agent Mesh or similar agentic AI platforms is a plus.
  • Proficiency in both Go and Python is an additional advantage.
  • Experience with messaging technologies such as Solace, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ, or TIBCO is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of LLM platforms and services, including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini/Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Foundry, is desirable.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or MLOps practices, including prompt and model versioning, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring, is a plus.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and regulatory requirements in industries such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector is advantageous.
  • Experience using AI-assisted and agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including the ability to demonstrate and share these practices with others.
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, and enterprise integration architectures is beneficial.
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified Machine Learning or Generative AI, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, are considered an advantage.
  • Previous experience creating technical workshops, reference architectures, blogs, presentations, or demonstrations focused on agentic AI is a plus.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: Attractive remuneration package aligned with your skills and professional experience.
  • Flexible working arrangements: Remote-first and hybrid working options designed to support different working preferences and locations.

jobs.title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
jobs.description:
Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development.
Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer.
Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau.
Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink!

Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes.

Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken.

Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships.

Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag:

  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken.

  • Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink.

  • Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven.

  • Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten.

  • Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem.

  • Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink.


WIE ZOEKEN WE?

We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen.

Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat.

Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt.

WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS?

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships, business development of relatiemanagement.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met partijen zoals card schemes, banken, issuers, acquirers, paymentnetwerken of andere organisaties binnen het betalingsverkeer.

  • Je hebt kennis van onderwerpen zoals scheme rules, scheme economics, fees, incentives en ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer.

  • Je bent gewend om complexe relaties en onderhandelingen op senior niveau te voeren.

  • Je kunt marktontwikkelingen, financiële belangen en inhoudelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere voorstellen en concrete resultaten.

  • Je communiceert overtuigend met zowel inhoudelijke experts als senior management en externe bestuurders.

  • Je bent organisatiesensitief, analytisch en zelfstandig en weet mensen mee te krijgen zonder formele hiërarchie.

  • Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend.

WAT BIEDT TRANSLINK JOU?

Translink is een leuke, uitdagende werkplek. We werken in een dynamische, veelzijdige omgeving met een hoog ontwikkeltempo. Samenwerken, Wendbaarheid en Zelfregie zijn onze kernwaarden en dat proef je op de werkvloer.

Translink biedt een prettige kantooromgeving met fijne werkplekken. Onze werksfeer is informeel, open en behulpzaam. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk. Vrij bewegen is ons motto. Je kunt in goed overleg hybride werken en we bieden bewegingsruimte om balans aan te brengen tussen je werk- en privéleven. Zo kun je met onze thuiswerkregeling ook thuis een fijne werkplek inrichten.

Voor je eigen ontwikkeling bieden wij de GoodHabitz online leeromgeving aan. Zo kun je jezelf continu blijven ontwikkelen. We hebben bij Translink ook de mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen, dit kan zowel voor privé als woon-werkverkeer.

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. Dit is afhankelijk van je ervaring en kwalificaties, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Daar bovenop ontvang je een keuzebudget van 6,94% van je salaris, dit is gemiddeld € 500,- p/m. Daarnaast krijg je 8% vakantiegeld, reiskosten en een goede pensioenregeling. Deze functie is voor minimaal 32 uur per week.

IS DEZE VACATURE OP JOUW LIJF GESCHREVEN?

jobs.title: Team Lead Customer Success (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Über eine halbe Million Gesundheitsfachkräfte und Millionen von Patient:innen nutzen Doctolib täglich. Damit unsere Kund:innen den vollen Wert unserer Lösungen ausschöpfen, suchen wir in Berlin eine Führungskraft, die unser Customer Success & Account Management Team für den Bestandskundenbereich leitet – in Vollzeit.

Die Rolle vereint zwei Verantwortungen: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskund:innen nach der Implementierung erfolgreich mit Doctolib arbeiten, und Du verantwortest gleichzeitig das Wachstum in diesen Accounts. Dein Team von 6-10 Customer Success Manager:innen und Account Manager:innen trägt ein gemeinsames Retention- und Expansion-Ziel – Du führst es dorthin.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Teams von 6-10 Customer Success Manager:innen und Account Manager:innen – von Coaching und Zielsetzung über 1:1s bis zur Rekrutierung neuer Teammitglieder

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Upsell- und Cross-Sell-Strategie für unser Bestandskundenportfolio – mit klarem Fokus auf langfristigem Kundenerfolg statt kurzfristigem Abschluss

  • Sicherstellung einer exzellenten Kundenbetreuung nach der Implementierung: Dein Team ist erste Anlaufstelle und sorgt für nachhaltige, optimale Nutzung unserer Software

  • Aufbau von Prozessen, die Retention und Wachstum planbar machen: Segmentierung, Health Scoring, Eskalationswege, Übergaben zwischen Sales, Implementation und Support

  • Steuerung anhand relevanter KPIs (u. a. Net Revenue Retention, Churn, Upsell-Umsatz, Aktivierungsgrad) und regelmäßiges Reporting an die Bereichsleitung

Dein Profil

Du bist überzeugt, dass Du das Richtige mitbringst? Dann bewirb Dich – auch wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst. Vielleicht bist Du genau die/der richtige Doctoliber:in für diese oder eine andere Stelle.

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung eines Teams im Customer Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb – idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu beiden Welten

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Umsatzverantwortung: Du hast ein Team-Quota oder ein Expansion-Ziel getragen und weißt, wie man es über Pipeline-Steuerung und Forecasting erreicht

  • Eigene Vertriebserfahrung im B2B-Umfeld, bevor Du in die Führung gewechselt bist – Du kannst ein Gespräch selbst führen, nicht nur bewerten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. Salesforce) und die Fähigkeit, aus Daten Entscheidungen abzuleiten

  • Verhandlungsgeschick und Überzeugungskraft, auch in schwierigen Kundensituationen und auf Entscheider-Ebene

  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit Kund:innen, angrenzenden Abteilungen und internationalen Teams

  • Fähigkeit, in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und Dein Team durch Veränderung zu führen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Erfahrung im SaaS-Umfeld, insbesondere mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten und wiederkehrenden Umsätzen

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen Gesundheitswesens oder Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Praxen, MVZ oder Kliniken

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Skalierung eines Teams, nicht nur in dessen Steuerung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Reporting- und Analysetools

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

Der Interview-Prozess

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer - Applied AI & LLMs (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
What you’ll do

We are looking for a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to join the DS & AI organization at Doctolib. This is a transversal force multiplier role operating across all AI teams: Clinical, Productivity, Phone Assistant and ASR. Rather than working within a single feature team, you will own the cross-cutting technical challenges: defining how Doctolib's product and AI teams build agentic solutions, standardizing ML evaluation frameworks, and spreading strong engineering practices across the org. You will unblock teams, shape architecture decisions, and take on the deep technical work that requires senior ML judgment at scale, directly impacting the daily lives of 400,000 healthcare professionals and the health of 80 million patients. Building at Doctolib means delivering innovative products that measurably improve outcomes for care teams and patients alike.

 

Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • Own cross-team ML architecture decisions, from model selection to production deployment patterns and strategic build vs. buy decisions

  • Define and drive adoption of rigorous evaluation frameworks across all AI teams, setting the standard for how Doctolib measures model and agentic performance

  • Establish shared production infrastructure patterns for AI: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimization, and observability

  • Lead the technical design of agentic solutions and define how product teams across Doctolib build on top of AI capabilities

  • Elevate technical standards across the DS & AI org by influencing Staff and Senior ML Engineers through architecture reviews, technical guidance, and practice propagation

  • Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure safe rollout and meet EU regulatory expectations (GDPR, MDR, EU AI Act)

 

Who you are

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if:

  • You have 10+ years in ML/AI with 3+ years at Staff+ or Principal level leading complex, multi-team technical initiatives

  • You have deep expertise in at least two of: clinical NLP, LLM fine-tuning and evaluation, automatic speech recognition, RAG systems, or reinforcement learning

  • You are expert in Python, PyTorch/Transformers for training, and vLLM for inference with a track record deploying ML systems in production (AWS/GCP)

  • You have a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent research experience)

  • You have exceptional communication skills and are able to align diverse stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions

Now it would be fantastic if you have:

  • Publications in top-tier ML/AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL) or medical informatics venues

  • Experience with EU healthcare regulations (GDPR, MDR, AI Act)

  • Prior work with clinical data or healthcare applications

 

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform supporting web and mobile interfaces across multiple languages and healthcare specialties.

  • Our stack includes Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically to empower patients and professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

 

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, support responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and partner organisations to turn strategic partnerships into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, and technology partners play a critical role in helping customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products. Our Partner Sales & Development team connects these partnerships to the field through joint account planning, opportunity development, coordinated sales execution, and delivery alignment that helps customers move from initial interest to production adoption.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partner Sales & Development Manager to lead our partner sales and development team for Southern EMEA. Reporting to the Head of GTM Partnerships, Europe you will manage and develop a regional team, own the regional partner business, and work alongside OpenAI Sales leadership and strategic partners to generate pipeline, advance complex pursuits, and drive revenue and customer adoption.

This is a people management role that combines team leadership, partner business development, co-sell execution, and operational discipline. You will translate broader partnership priorities into a focused regional plan, set team goals and account coverage, and coach your team to engage the right partners at the right point in the customer journey. You will build relationships with partner field leaders and remain hands-on in priority pursuits, working with technical and delivery teams to turn commercial commitments into sustained customer value.

You will be accountable for both regional business performance and the success of your team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who can hire and develop talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the partner sales and development plan for your assigned region, Southern Europe, aligning team coverage, target accounts, partner priorities, sales plays, and execution milestones with regional Sales leadership

  • Drive regional commercial outcomes across partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, bookings, production adoption, and expansion, with clear accountability for business performance.

  • Identify and develop new partner-led opportunities. Evaluate where partners can create differentiated customer value, establish executive sponsorship, and build a path from initial engagement to joint execution.

  • Orchestrate complex co-sell pursuits, aligning account teams, partner sellers, technical stakeholders, and services organizations around customer needs, clear responsibilities, and mutual action plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional partner executives and field leaders, while coordinating with global partner owners to ensure regional execution supports the broader partnership strategy.

  • Establish disciplined pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and performance reporting. Use evidence to assess partner contribution, diagnose underperformance, and adjust investments and priorities.

  • Navigate complex stakeholder relationships, commercial tradeoffs, and competing priorities with sound judgment, working across Legal, Security, Finance, and other teams as needed.

  • Hire, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional partner sales and development team. Set individual and team goals, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and support career growth.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise sales, partner sales, strategic alliances, or business development within cloud, AI, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, or technology partner ecosystems, and an understanding of how their field organizations sell and deliver.

  • Experience creating opportunities and leading complex partnerships or customer engagements from discovery and qualification through commercial execution, launch, adoption, and expansion.

  • Strong enterprise sales fundamentals, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • The ability to earn trust with Sales leaders, partner executives, technical teams, and peers, and to resolve disagreements constructively in a matrixed organization.

  • Technical-commercial fluency: you can understand customer use cases, translate partner needs into clear requirements, and engage product and technical teams on implementation tradeoffs.

  • Strong operational judgment and a builder mindset. You can create structure where a playbook does not yet exist, adapt as priorities change, and move quickly without sacrificing customer trust.

  • Clear communication, executive presence, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach to feedback and problem-solving.

Preferred qualifications:

As we expand our AI capabilities, our approach to Solutions Consulting is evolving. Beyond traditional product demonstrations and technical evaluations, we're increasingly helping customers integrate Patsnap's intelligence, AI agents and data directly into their existing systems and business workflows.

You'll lead an established global team of Solutions Consultants, strengthening its technical capabilities and expanding the function through the introduction of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). This role offers the opportunity to have a genuine impact on how we operate, how we support our customers and how we bring our next generation of AI capabilities to market.
